description: Athletics records: Indonesian national records (senior, U20, U18) from PASI; world records, world U20 records, world U18 best performances and Asian records from World Athletics. Per record: event (atletik-nomor code), mark as printed and normalised (seconds, metres or points), wind, holders with birth date as published, province (wilayah code) or country, competition, date, venue, indoor/pending/hand-timed flags; errata and a Wikipedia cross-check.
status: ready for national (PASI) and World Athletics lists; championship records (O2SN, POPDA, POPNAS, the user's championships) and U16/U14 national records not published (F-037)
source: PASI national record tables at www.pbpasi.org (senior men updated 23 Jun 2025, senior women 9 Dec 2024, U20 and U18 5 Dec 2023), World Athletics record lists at worldathletics.org/records (fetched 2026-11-27); English Wikipedia list of Indonesian records (CC BY-SA) for the cross-check only. Raw files and SOURCE.txt in sources/atletik-rekor/
licence: PASI and World Athletics publish the records publicly; facts with references (F-027, F-037). Holders' names and birth dates appear only as the federations publish them (F-037)
procedure: node tools/converters/atletik-rekor-fetch.mjs sources/atletik-rekor/wa (World Athletics pages need a browser); curl for the PASI pages; then python3 -I tools/converters/atletik-rekor.py sources/atletik-rekor data and tools/data-check --write
